alps.title: BEAR.ApiDoc API Documentation Profile
alps.doc: ALPS profile describing the structure of API documentation generated by BEAR.ApiDoc. This documentation is auto-generated from BEAR.Sunday resource classes, JSON Schema, and apidoc.xml configuration.

descriptor.title: API Endpoint
descriptor.doc: A REST API endpoint defined by a BEAR.Sunday resource class. The path corresponds to the resource URI.

descriptor.title: HTTP Method
descriptor.doc: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) mapped from resource class methods (onGet, onPost, etc.). GET is safe, PUT/DELETE are idempotent, POST/PATCH are unsafe.

descriptor.title: Request Parameter
descriptor.doc: Method parameter with type, constraints, and description. Validated by JSON Schema defined in @JsonSchema annotation's params attribute.

descriptor.title: Response Schema
descriptor.doc: Response structure defined by JSON Schema. Links to Objects section for detailed property documentation.

descriptor.title: Response Object
descriptor.doc: Data structure returned by API endpoints. Properties, types, and constraints are extracted from JSON Schema files.

descriptor.title: Documentation Link
descriptor.doc: External links configured in apidoc.xml. Includes references to project homepage, issues, OpenAPI spec, and JSON Schema index.
